question: An n-type semiconductor is created by doping Silicon with Phosphorus. Although it has a large concentration of free electrons, the crystal as a whole remains electrically neutral. Explain the physical reason for this neutrality.

options.A: The extra electrons are neutralized by the holes produced by thermal excitation.
options.B: The negative charge of the free electrons is exactly balanced by the positive charge of the immobile ionized donor cores.
options.C: The electrons reside in the conduction band where they do not contribute to the net charge of the crystal.
options.D: The external battery supplies positive charges to neutralize the electrons.
